style.vernacular: Dust-coloured city of buff fired-brick and plastered concrete-frame buildings with flat roofs, parapets and rooftop water tanks. Old Tigris-side quarters have Ottoman-era brick houses with timber shanasheel bay windows and arched openings; mid-century modernist blocks (1950s-70s) in concrete with brise-soleil; large state buildings clad in marble or pale stone; mosques with gold or turquoise domes and tall minarets. Date palms and eucalyptus line streets and the river.
style.ornament: Timber shanasheel (enclosed bay windows) and arched brick openings on old houses; gold-plated and turquoise-tile domes and minarets; muqarnas; geometric brick patterning; marble-clad portals on state buildings; mid-century concrete brise-soleil screens.
